title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly rely on persistent natural-language skills to adapt beyond their frozen model parameters. When a shared skill is repeatedly revised from a non-stationary, heterogeneous task stream, however, improvements for new tasks can overwrite procedures needed for earlier ones. In continual learning, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD) addresses analogous interference by projecting a new-task gradient onto a subspace that locally preserves prior predictions. Natural-language skill revisions, however, have neither gradients nor a canonical vector space in which such a projection can be performed. We introduce \emph{Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution} (SSPE), which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space. translated_title: 面向语言智能体持续自我进化的语义投影
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越依赖持久化的自然语言技能，以在其冻结的模型参数之外实现适应。然而，当某个共享技能在非平稳、异构的任务流中被反复修改时，针对新任务的改进可能会覆盖早期任务所需的操作流程。在持续学习领域，正交梯度下降通过将新任务的梯度投影到一个能够局部保留先前预测的子空间中，来解决类似的干扰问题。然而，自然语言技能的修改既没有梯度，也不存在可以执行此类投影的规范向量空间。我们提出了语义范围投影进化，它将梯度投影的功能原理从参数空间迁移到了行为空间。SSPE将一次不受约束的技能修改视为一个提议的更新，识别出其可能干扰的已获得能力，并利用观察到的增益和……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SSPE方法，将梯度投影原理从参数空间迁移到行为空间，通过识别并规避技能修改对已获得能力的干扰，实现语言智能体自然语言技能的持续自我进化而不遗忘旧任务所需的流程。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SSPE, which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space, protecting previously acquired capabilities from interference during skill revisions to enable continual self-evolution of language agents.
